item.title: Iranian sea trade blocked as six ships forced to turn back, U.S. military says
item.summary: A U.S. blockade in effect since Monday has completely cut off Iran’s sea trade, the U.S. military said after six merchant ships were prevented from leaving Iranian ports.

item.title: White House favors Erica Schwartz, former deputy surgeon general, to lead CDC
item.summary: Schwartz would be Trump’s third nominee to lead the agency. The administration is also said to be looking at three other people to serve in senior roles supporting her.

item.title: U.S. sends thousands more troops to Mideast as Trump seeks to squeeze Iran
item.summary: The deployment includes sailors and Marines due to arrive as the administration attempts to enforce a maritime blockade against the regime in Tehran.

item.title: Trump says Iran talks may resume this week, but opposes enrichment compromise
item.summary: The lead U.S. negotiator, Vice President JD Vance, has sought a moratorium on uranium enrichment of at least 20 years. Tehran’s offer would last up to five.

item.title: Orban’s defeat offers warning signs for Trump allies
item.summary: Some factors that harmed Orban may also apply to Republicans in this year’s midterm elections, say American conservatives who backed the Hungarian leader.

item.title: Lambasting Pope Leo, Trump risks alienating conservative Catholics
item.summary: Veteran church observers say an open war of words between a pope and a U.S. president is unprecedented.

item.title: What Swalwell’s exit means for Democrats in California’s governor race
item.summary: Billionaire Tom Steyer and ex-congresswoman Katie Porter stand to benefit the most in a Democratic field with no clear front-runner, several strategists said.

item.title: DOJ accuses Biden administration of weaponizing abortion access law
item.summary: A long-awaited report from the Justice Department’s “Weaponization Working Group” alleges misuse of the Face Act. But the evidence is limited, and the Trump administration has itself been criticized for misusing law enforcement.

item.title: Ex-Pence aide Olivia Troye plans to run for Congress in Virginia as a Democrat
item.summary: She joins other former Republicans and Trump administration officials running for office as critics of the president. The district would open up if voters approve a new map.

item.title: In this U.S. hot spot for data centers, voters have turned against them
item.summary: Virginians previously embraced the facilities, but a Post-Schar School poll finds they are now almost as undesirable as nuclear power plants.
